records.title: 10-Q
records.text: During both the 2022 and 2021 first quarters approximately 65% of KMT inland revenues were under term contracts and 35% were spot contract revenues.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Consequently, KMT is directly affected by the volumes produced by the Company’s petroleum, petrochemical and refining customer base.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: During the 2022 first quarter, the Company's inland tank barge count and capacity was unchanged.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The increases for the 2022 first quarter were primarily due to increased tank barge utilization and term and spot pricing in the inland market and increased fuel rebills in the inland and coastal markets.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Cash provided by operating activities for the 2022 first quarter decreased primarily due to the receipt of a tax refund of $119.5 million, including accrued interest, for the Company’s 2019 federal tax return during the 2021 first quarter.
